content.title: Friday the 13th is here again. How many 'unlucky' dates are in 2026?
content.text: March 13, 2026, 1:05 p.m. ETAnother Friday the 13th has arrived, the second of three dates in 2026.The first Friday the 13th of 2026 fell just before Valentine's Day on Feb. 13. The second falls just days before St. Patrick's Day. There are three of the holidays in 2026, the maximum possible number of Friday the 13th dates in one calendar year, with the third falling in November.Here's what to know about the date, why some consider it unlucky and more.When is the next Friday the 13th? How many times will Friday the 13th happen in 2026?The next Friday the 13th date following March 13 will fall on Nov. 13. According to The Old Farmer's Almanac, 2026 has three Friday the 13th dates, the most possible dates in a single year. This occurs only two out of 14 years.A look at Friday the 13ths this year:Feb. 13March 13Nov. 13Perhaps luckily, the next two years, 2027 and 2028, bring just one Friday the 13th in the year, according to Date and Time.Why is Friday the 13th unlucky?The day has an unlucky association stemming from Christianity, according to History.com. There were 13 people present during the Last Supper of Jesus in the Bible, which occurred on a Thursday. Jesus was crucified the following day.In a previous interview with USA TODAY, Dr. Phil Stevens, author and retired anthropology professor, said the number "is associated with that terrible event. And Friday, the 13th, you get a double whammy. You get both of these elements coming together: the taboo against 13, and the crucifixion, which was on a Friday."Friday the 13th deals and eventsSome chain businesses mark Friday the 13th with deals. For March, Chipotle has a BOGO entrée deal for those rocking (real or temporary) tattoos and Krispy Kreme customers can get a dozen original glazed doughnuts for 13 cents with the purchase of any dozen at regular price.Local businesses in the Western North Carolina area are also no strangers to similar deals, with many tattoo shops in particular offering special prices and designs every Friday the 13th.Several events are also taking place in the Western N.C. area in honor of the occasion, including fusion dance at the YMI Cultural Center at 39 S Market St, Asheville and a wax carving workshop at Torched AVL, 1056 Haywood Rd A, Asheville.What are some Friday the 13th superstitions?Some common superstitions associated with bad luck on Friday the 13th include:Breaking a mirror: Breaking a mirror is said to bring seven years of bad luck, so handle glass carefully on Friday the 13th.Walking under a ladder: This superstition stems from the idea that walking under a ladder disrupts the triangle, a symbol of life, and invites misfortune.Spilling salt: Accidentally spilling salt has been seen as bad luck for centuries. To counteract, throw a pinch over your left shoulder to ward off evil.Crossing paths with a black cat: Black cats, often associated with witches and bad omens, are considered unlucky, especially when they cross your path on Friday the 13th.Stepping on cracks: The rhyme "step on a crack, break your mother's back" comes from the idea that stepping on cracks invites bad energy or harm.Michelle Del Rey, USA TODAY, contributed to this report.Iris Seaton is the trending news reporter for the Asheville Citizen Times, part of the USA TODAY Network. Reach her at iseaton@citizentimes.com.
